title: CustomerResponseDecisionPayload
description: The single final customer response decision emitted by the Customer Resolution Agent for one ticket. Event type: local.customer.resolution.decided.v1. Exactly one per resolved ticket (FR-007).

correlation_id.description: Case identity; equals the originating ticket envelope's correlation_id.

outcome.description: approve/deny/escalate for refund-review tickets; direct_response for non-refund tickets.

customer_response.description: The drafted customer-facing message for this outcome.

rationale.description: Auditable explanation of how the outcome was reached from triage + findings.

escalation_reason.description: Required (non-null) iff outcome == escalate_human; null otherwise (FR-010). One of: peer_failure, peer_rejection, elevated_risk, conflicting_analyses, peer_requested_review.

billing_summary.description: Traceability to the billing analysis result that informed the decision (US5-2). Null for direct_response.

risk_summary.description: Traceability to the risk analysis result that informed the decision (US5-2). Null for direct_response.

decided_by_agent_id.description: Always the resolution agent; it owns the decision.
